{{{{{1|Crafting Infobox}}} |image = Small Hardwood Fence |Source = [[Crafting]] |Sell Price = {{Price|30}} |Recipe = Default |Ingredients = {{NameSDV|Hardwood|1}} }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a new type of [[Crafting|craftable]] fence used on the farm that lasts as long as [[Stardew:Hardwood Fence|Hardwood Fences]] (roughly 502 to 505 in-game days). They can be removed with any level of [[Stardew:Axes|Axe]]. {{Info|For clarification on vanilla Fence behavior, see [[Stardew:Crafting#Fences|Stardew Valley wiki - Fences]].}} ==Recipe Source== The crafting recipe is a default recipe and is known at save creation. ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a universally '''disliked''' item. ==Bundles== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any bundles. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in tailoring or in dyeing. ==History== * v.1.15: Introduced
